hostOS is unstated: no worker's os-release could be read, which on a probe is the host's root filesystem not having been mounted into it. The cluster this expands into states no host OS either
enableJournalDevice is set because spec.discover.forceJournalDevice asked for it: the smallest disk of every node carries the journal instead of data, the smallest named being 100G (/dev/sdb) on githubactions-lblk-storage-node-1. This is the line to remove to carve the journal from a partition instead
stripe is 1+1, the only redundant scheme a fleet of 3 carries: it needs 3 storage nodes and the next scheme up needs more. A cluster's stripe cannot be changed afterward
enableNodeAffinity is set, because a 1+1 stripe is a mirror and reads are served from the local node's copy first. The control plane takes it at cluster create and never re-applies it, so this is the line to remove now if reads should not prefer the local node
wrote discovered-discover-host-02 in Draft: 3 workers with 6 block devices, in 1 group(s) across 1 node set(s); 77 refusal(s)
